content.short: Tradoor is a high-speed decentralized derivatives exchange on TON focusing on low-latency perpetual trading.
content.description: Tradoor is a high-performance decentralized derivatives exchange on the TON blockchain, engineered for exceptional speed and low-latency execution. It provides traders with a professional environment for trading perpetual futures with significant leverage, backed by advanced risk management and a robust liquidity model. By leveraging TON's scalable architecture, Tradoor delivers a seamless trading experience that rivals centralized exchanges while maintaining the security and transparency of a non-custodial protocol, catering to the needs of professional and retail traders alike.
